summary: Iteration 28: frontend-only retest of the offline Playgama build at /pgtest/index.html. The build is from 14:23, the same time as the sources, and the bundle contains the fixes. Tested at 1920x1080 in fresh contexts with seeded saves (pg_seed.js, pg_seed28.js, pg_seed28b.js). ALL 5 REQUESTED FIXES VERIFIED: (1) The partial contract hand-in toast reads 'Handed in 1, deliver 5× bluegill is 1/5' with no 'undefined'. The card shows 1/5. (2) The Pearl Shop tabs are only FRAMES (default, active), CHAT COLOURS and COMING SOON. There is no portraits grid. Buying Hemp Rope moved pearls from 32 to 22 with the toast 'Bought the Hemp Rope frame' and the card 'Owned | In use'. Save shows cos.frames=['frame_rope'] and frame='frame_rope' after a reload. The colours grid and the coming-soon panel render. (3) Casting with d_cast 'Patience' seeded at 0/1 shows the toast 'Quest complete: Patience | +100 gold · +50 XP · +1 Pearl'. The cast also showed 'Achievement unlocked: Comfortable' once (gold_10k crossed by the quest reward). (4) The story list (17 chapters) has no merchants_wager or old_salts_recipe. With tide_tables done at level 15, harrows_teeth is Available. Accepting it gives 'Quest accepted' and IN PROGRESS 0/5, and the later chapters stay locked. (5) Achievement toasts appear once: the contract full hand-in showed 'Achievement unlocked: Reliable Hands' x1, and the bulk sell showed 'Achievement unlocked: Market Regular' x1. REGRESSION: OK. Catch popup plus 'Quest complete: Casting Off' plus 'First Blood' toasts each appear once, and story, catches, gold and pearls persist across a reload. A full contract hand-in toasts 'Honest Work' and the contract fill. No /api/ calls to the app origin (the only /api/ hits go to api.playgama.com bridge timestamp, the SDK, not the app) and 0 page errors. NEW ISSUE: the exclusion added to stop double toasts makes single-fish sells from the catch popup unlock achievements silently offline.

integration_issues.issue: Reproduced. Seeded stats.sold=99, caught a fish and pressed catch-sell-btn. The save gained 'sold_100' (Market Regular, +500 gold, +1 Pearl) but the only toast was 'Sold for 171 gold'. Cause: the api.js:32 interceptor now skips new_achievements for any URL matching /inventory/sell. The bulk sell in Inventory.js toasts them itself, but world/CatchCard.js:42 (catch-sell-btn) and tfl/pages/game/Fishing.js act() (catch-sell-button) also post to /inventory/sell and never toast achievements. The same applies to sell-triggered gold_10k/100k/1m. Fix: drop the URL exclusion and remove the per-page toasts in Contracts.js:172 and Inventory.js:124/190 when OFFLINE, or give toasts a stable id (toast.success(..., {id: 'ach-'+a.id})) so sonner de-dupes them.

design_issues.screen: Pearl Shop (known LOW copy issues, out of scope)
issues: The 'How to earn' table and the intro still list online-only sources: Day-7 Harbour Chest, Legendary boss, Tournament podium, Toplist vote, and Angler Pass on the Donate page.
The Coming soon text mentions 'trophy-wall themes'.

action_items: Offline single-fish sells (catch popup catch-sell-btn and catch-sell-button) unlock achievements without a toast. De-dupe achievement toasts by id instead of excluding /inventory/sell in the api.js interceptor (or toast them in CatchCard.js/Fishing.js too).
Optional (LOW, known): offline copy in the Pearl Shop 'How to earn', Achievements header and Contracts intro.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js:32: the URL-regex exclusion (/\/contracts\/|\/inventory\/sell/) is fragile because it couples the interceptor to page-level toast logic. A sonner toast id per achievement ('ach-<id>') would de-dupe every path and let the per-page toasts stay as they are.

harbour.js: questsOut() (GET /quests) is not wrapped in ok(), so freshly rolled daily/weekly quests are only persisted by the next saving call. This is harmless because the roll is deterministic per day, but a fresh save has no 'h' until a saving harbour route runs.

harbour.js storyStatus: a save with a skipped chapter (merchants_wager/old_salts_recipe) left 'active' from an older build will never progress or block. This is fine, but there is no migration or cleanup.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (5/5 requested fixes + regression pass; 1 new minor integration issue)

seed_data_creation: Browser-local saves only, via window.bridge.storage.set(['fishyland_save']). pg_seed28.js: contracts total 9, story done through tide_tables, level 15. pg_seed28b.js: d_cast Patience at 0/1, sold 99, gold 9990, 30 pearls. Before pg_seed28b, open the quests and contracts spots so that save.h and the daily quests exist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: exec pg_helpers.py, pg_harbour.py, pg_setup.py. A fresh save has no d.h until a saving harbour route runs (contracts GET is saving; quests GET is not). Open quests then contracts before seeding the daily quests. After a reload the player is at the harbour, so call to_millbrook(page) before fish_until_catch. GETSAVE right after an action can show stale values because saves are debounced; reload first to confirm persistence. Catch popup sell = [data-testid=catch-sell-btn]. Pearl Shop frame buy = shop-frame-buy-<id>, with no confirm dialog for frames.
rca of the issue: Silent achievement on a single sell: in iteration 27 the interceptor toasted all offline new_achievements, so the per-page toasts doubled them. The fix excluded /contracts/ and /inventory/sell from the interceptor, but /inventory/sell has three callers (Inventory bulk sell, CatchCard sell, Fishing catch-sell-button) and only the bulk one toasts. Repro: set stats.sold=99, catch a fish, press Sell on the popup. sold_100 is added to the save and no achievement toast appears.
